title: Qambar aur fizza
body:
Qambar aur fizza
Suno suno suno suno.(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
hai dosto ye chashme tasawwur ka waqea
ek din hua jo qambar o fizza ka saamna
<<DIVIDER>>
dono ko ehle bait ki nisbat pe naaz tha
phir ye hua ke chhid gaya rutbo ka tazkera
<<DIVIDER>>
is ghar ke naukro ke hai kya aabru suno
us dam hui thi dono me jo guftugu suno
<<DIVIDER>>
suno suno, qambar aur fizza ki guftugu suno
1. Qambar ye bola sabse hai rutba mera juda
<<DIVIDER>>
mashhoor do jaha me hu mai abd e mustafa
maula ne yu kiya meri qismat ka faisla
<<DIVIDER>>
shayan e shaan martaba mujhko ataa hua
sad shukr mai ghulam e janabe ameer hu
<<DIVIDER>>
shaho ko bheek deta hu aisa faqeer hu
2. Fizza ne di sada mere pucho na martabe
<<DIVIDER>>
tey karti hu mai lamho me sadyo ke faasle
mashhoor do jahaan me hai mere waqea
<<DIVIDER>>
hote hai arsh walo me bhi mere tazkere
bus ye sifat hi kaafi hai kaunain ke liye
<<DIVIDER>>
mai rotiya pakati hu hasnain k liye
3. Qambar ye bola aaj suno mere mojizat
<<DIVIDER>>
bus mai hi jaanta hu ghulami ki kul sifat
jis dam ali ke qadmo pe hote hai mere haath
<<DIVIDER>>
mehsus mujhko hoti hai mutthi me kayenaat
thokar se meri noor ke chashme ubharte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
shams o qamar bhi mere ishare pe chalte hai
4. Fizza ne daad deke kaha meri baat sun
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisi hasi mili hai mujhe kayenaat sun
wo tere mojize the mere mojizaat sun
<<DIVIDER>>
pohche hai kis maqam pe fizza ke haath sun
maine hasan husain ko inse uthaya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ko mere haatho ne chalna sikhaya hai
5. Qambar ye bola sach hai mai koi nabi nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
mere liye to koi shariyat bani nahi
mujhko koi kitaab khuda se mili nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
par mere ikhteyaar me bhi kuch kami nahi
haider ki naukri ke sabab kaamyaab hu
<<DIVIDER>>
mai chalti phirti ishq e ali ki kitaab hu
6. Fizza ye boli dekha hai ismat ka maine noor
<<DIVIDER>>
khair un nisa ke faiz se hasil hai ye ghuroor
maryam se badhke bakhsha gaya hai mujhe sha'oor
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhse rakha hai fatima zehra ne rijs door
khilqat se khaake khidmate binte rasool hu
<<DIVIDER>>
sadqa hai ye batool ka mai bhi batool hu
7. Qambar ye bola maanne wala hu asl ka
<<DIVIDER>>
qael hu dil se mai bhi bila fasl wasl ka
seekha hai ba ke nuqte se har nuqta aql ka
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhko mila hai dars imamat se adl ka
saani nahi hai koi mera khaas o aam me
<<DIVIDER>>
maula ne mera haath bataya hai kaam me
8. Fizza ye boli haan ye ali ka usool hai
<<DIVIDER>>
yeh bhi to soch meri muddaris batool hai
jiske sabab shariyaton ka arz o tool hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ehsaan kisi ka fatima ko kab qabool hai
binte nabi say main ne masawaat seekhi hay
<<DIVIDER>>
Khud fatima ne chakki mere saath pisi hay
9. Akbar qalam ko rok le mushkil hai faisla
<<DIVIDER>>
is dar ki naukri ka sharaf hai bohot bada
kitni fazeelaton ka hai manzar yeh martaba
<<DIVIDER>>
yeh khadim e Ali hai woh zehra ki khadima
dono ki baat apni jaga lajawab hai
<<DIVIDER>>
in ki koi misaal na un ka jawab hai
author: Mir Hassan Mir
